title: LOCAL model timeout
text: LOCAL model responses can slow down or time out when the prompt is too large. Reducing retrieved context, using a smaller prompt, or checking the local model endpoint usually resolves the issue.

title: REMOTE provider unavailable
text: If the REMOTE provider fails, verify the API key and base URL. Network connectivity or provider-side issues can also cause temporary failures.

title: RAG answer seems incomplete
text: RAG answers depend on indexed documents and retrieval confidence. If the relevant document is missing or retrieval confidence is low, the answer may say that context is insufficient.

title: App keeps showing loading
text: A persistent loading state usually means the model request is still running or the local endpoint is unreachable. Check the selected provider and the configured local base URL.
